Article id: configure-online-appointment-booking
Article: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
Enable patients to schedule routine visits directly through the web and mobile portal by configuring your scheduling rules. Only providers with active schedules and visit types marked as 'Online Eligible' will appear to patients.

1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules**.
2. Toggle on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
3. Navigate to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select a visit type, and check the box for **Available Online**.
4. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, designate which staff members accept online requests.

**Limits & Conditions:**
Patients can only book appointments between 24 hours and 60 days in advance. Urgent visit types cannot be made available online.

**Troubleshooting:**
If a provider does not appear for booking, verify their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

Ticket:
Inquiry Regarding Online Patient Booking Restrictions

Good morning. We are currently reviewing our web portal configuration and wish to restrict online patient scheduling so that only routine physicals can be booked through the public link. Could you please advise on the proper steps to limit these visit types and exclude certain providers from the web-booking roster? Thank you for your assistance with this matter.

Auto-reply:
To limit online booking to routine physicals only, follow these steps:
1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules** and ensure **Allow Online Appointment Booking** is enabled.
2. Open **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select the routine physical visit type, and check **Available Online**. Make sure all other visit types (especially urgent ones) are unchecked.
3. In **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, select only the providers you want to appear for online booking and deselect any you wish to exclude.
These settings will restrict the public link to routine physicals and the chosen providers only.

Source: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients (configure-online-appointment-booking)
